record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (68%) to LL-25 K: 40%, F: 15%. Activity: active against S. aureus (MIC 30 ug/ml), B. subtilis (MIC 20 ug/ml), E. coli (MIC 32 ug/ml), and P. aeruginosa (MIC 20 ug/ml). Structure: random coil in buffer and helical in TFE or SDS. In vitro toxicity: not hemo.lytic till 100 uM.
